messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 4059876543 detected — elevated 5xx rate from nyc-edge-gateway (NYC-EDGE-PROXY). Auto-paging oncall. Dashboard: https://ops.redwood.internal/incident/4059876543

sara: @oncall-ops seeing a sharp spike of 502/503 from NYC. 2m error rate ~8% (alert threshold 1%). p50 latency up ~350ms.

mike: on it. pulling proxy logs - looks like upstream 502 / connection reset by peer. `upstream: mlworker-nyc-1` showing repeated `RST` and `read timeout`.

leo: could be backend overload or a bad retriever upstream. Anyone from infra/redis watching?

hana: traces show many requests are timing out inside mlworker while waiting on retriever service. Lots of retries => amplification.

aj: suggestion: partial traffic shift to eu-west for user-facing routes while we triage. start with 20-30% to avoid global blast radius.

sara: executing controlled reroute: `trafficctl reroute --from nyc-edge --to eu-west --weight 30 --reason "nyc 5xx mitigation"` — monitoring.

incident-bot: Deploybot: autoscaler triggered for mlworker-nyc-1 group, requested +4 replicas.

mike: autoscale happened but errors persist. Looking deeper: tcp resets to `redis-nyc-1:6379` and `blocked_clients` on redis spiked.

eli: redis metrics: blocked_clients=1200, cpu_sys=92%. Looks like a hot-key pattern causing client blocking.

hana: runbook step: drain suspected edge pool to stop sending to overloaded backend. command: `edgectl drain-pool nyc-pool-7 --grace 30s` — who will run?

aj: executing drain now.

sara: Customer impact: CS dashboard shows ~23 complaints in last 10m localized to NYC-based customers. Not global but visible. Flagging for comms.

mike: after draining nyc-pool-7 5xx fell from 8% -> 1.2% within 90s. Good sign.

leo: flipping circuit-breaker open for mlworker-nyc-1 to avoid retry storms: `cb open mlworker-nyc-1 --auto-reset 5m`.

hana: tracing indicates the retriever host `retriever-ext-nyc` reporting 500/timeout. That delays mlworker which then blocks on redis for repeated keys.

aj: propose enabling degraded retriever mode (serve local index / stale results) for nyc region to avoid the slow external retriever. will throttle calls to external.

sara: enabling degraded retriever for region=nyc: `featureflag set retriever_degraded=true --region=nyc --by=ops` — applied.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled at +25m to @leo for extended monitoring.

mike: error rate now ~0.4%, latencies back to baseline. Continuing to watch dashboards and logs.

eli: pushed a targeted redis-evict for the hot prefix `session:llm:prompt_cache:*`. Command used (ran carefully):
```
redis-cli --scan --pattern "session:llm:prompt_cache:*" | xargs -n 100 redis-cli --pipe <<<'<payload>'
```
This reduced blocked_clients to ~30 and CPU normalized.

hana: confirmed tracing spans returning to normal after retriever degraded-mode and evict. No new retries.

aj: opening ticket IR-2026-405987 with timeline, mitigation steps, and follow-ups: redis sharding review, retriever SLA guardrails, add fallback mode docs, and update traffic-steer playbook.

sara: handoff notes for @leo: leave retriever_degraded=true for NYC until retriever service patch & SLA verified, keep cb open for mlworker-nyc-1 for 5m windows, monitor redis blocked_clients and current_error_rate > 0.5% -> escalate.

leo: will take night watch for 60m. Will revert degraded-mode only after retriever signals healthy and error rate stable <0.2% for 10m.

mike: before handing off, running a small synthetic load test to confirm pool stability: `loadtest --target nyc-edge --qps 10 --duration 5m`. Results look stable.

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to S2. Next automated check in 30m or on manual update.

sara: notifying CS to prepare customer comms (internal note only for now). Adding postmortem owner: @aj.

eli: follow-ups captured: [1] Add alert for redis `blocked_clients > 200` per node. [2] Add retriever latency SLO monitor + automated degraded-mode toggle. [3] Audit cache key patterns to avoid hot prefixes and introduce sharding TTL. [4] Update runbook to include partial-traffic-shift command snippets.

hana: good triage. marking thread for postmortem writeup tomorrow 1000-1100.

sara: closing live thread, timeline recorded. End timestamp: 4059876850. Thanks all :thumbsup:
